description: Zero applicable vacancies verdict requires verified complete vacancy matrix. Partial tables cannot self-declare completeness.

requirementsForMatrixComplete.nonEmptyRows: rows array must contain at least one quota row.
requirementsForMatrixComplete.rowLevelEvidence: Every vacancy row must contain verifiable evidenceRefs or source locator.
requirementsForMatrixComplete.categoryBreakdown: Must account for vertical and horizontal reservation distributions.

matchingEngineBehavior.completeMatrixZeroMatches: When matrix is VACANCY_MATRIX_COMPLETE and user matches 0 rows -> NO_APPLICABLE_VACANCIES.
matchingEngineBehavior.partialMatrixZeroMatches: When matrix is VACANCY_MATRIX_PARTIAL or TOTAL_SEATS_ONLY and user matches 0 rows -> VACANCIES_PENDING_RESERVATION_DATA (never false rejection!).
